title: How (un)ethical are instruction-centric responses of LLMs? Unveiling the vulnerabilities of safety guardrails to harmful queries

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the percentage of harmful or unethical responses generated by LLMs when prompted with plain text versus instruction-centric formats (pseudocode) using the 'Hate Speech and Discrimination' subset of the NicheHazardQA baseline dataset, with GPT-4 acting as an automated judge.
